name: open-photon-comfy
readme: Open Photon's self-hosted Comfy target: ComfyUI 0.42.0 (7a28332) with the Wan Animate 2 weights from models.lock, behind comfy-api-proxy 0.1.6 on port 8189 (Comfy API v2, bearer PROXY_TOKEN). Needs one GPU with at least 32 GB VRAM (RTX 5090 measured at 31,066 MiB peak) and a CUDA 13 driver: create pods with --min-cuda-version 13.0. Attach a network volume at /workspace to keep the ~26 GB of weights between pods; the first boot downloads them. Point the app at https://<pod-id>-8189.proxy.runpod.net with COMFY_API_KEY set to the token. See docs/selfhost.md in the open-photon repository.
